execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Branch" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "region" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Branch_name_check_ca88058c" CHECK ("name" IN ('ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX', 'SEVEN', 'EIGHT')),
  CONSTRAINT "Branch_region_check_de154a3d" CHECK ("region" IN ('ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX', 'SEVEN', 'EIGHT', 'NINE', 'TEN', 'ELEVEN', 'TWELVE', 'THIRTEEN', 'FOURTEEN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Contact" (
  "address" jsonb,
  "branchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "branchRole" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_contacted" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "last_contacted_byId" int4,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "region" text,
  "schoolId" int4,
  "subject" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Contact_region_check_de154a3d" CHECK ("region" IN ('ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX', 'SEVEN', 'EIGHT', 'NINE', 'TEN', 'ELEVEN', 'TWELVE', 'THIRTEEN', 'FOURTEEN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Employee" (
  "address" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_online" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "region" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Employee_region_check_de154a3d" CHECK ("region" IN ('ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX', 'SEVEN', 'EIGHT', 'NINE', 'TEN', 'ELEVEN', 'TWELVE', 'THIRTEEN', 'FOURTEEN')),
  CONSTRAINT "Employee_role_check_b697a84e" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'WORKSHOPS_COORDINATOR', 'SCHOOL_NETWORK_COORDINATOR', 'STORIES_OF_OUR_NEIGHBORS_COORDINATOR', 'VETERANS_DAY_COORDINATOR', 'NEWSLETTER_COORDINATOR'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Municipality" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mayor" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MunicipalityPrograms" (
  "municipalityId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "programId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("municipalityId", "programId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Participation" (
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "programId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PLANNED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Participation_status_check_07ec6707" CHECK ("status" IN ('PLANNED', 'ONGOING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ParticipationEmployees" (
  "employeeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "participationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("participationId", "employeeId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Program" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."School" (
  "address" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "branchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "region" text NOT NULL,
  "relationship" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "School_region_check_de154a3d" CHECK ("region" IN ('ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX', 'SEVEN', 'EIGHT', 'NINE', 'TEN', 'ELEVEN', 'TWELVE', 'THIRTEEN', 'FOURTEEN')),
  CONSTRAINT "School_relationship_check_15167c09" CHECK ("relationship" IN ('POOR', 'AVERAGE', 'EXCELLENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "School_type_check_b97fb405" CHECK ("type" IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY', 'UNDERGRADUATE', 'GRADUATE', 'POSTGRADUATE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SchoolEmployees" (
  "employeeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "schoolId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("schoolId", "employeeId")
)
